public_sources_reviewed.finding: The public interface page documents the MDD data access surface but does not expose a provider API-key quota reset timezone or exact reset instant.
The public terms page does not establish a machine-readable monthly quota reset boundary for this credential.
The portal exposes a monthly quota field and month/year request history, but the exact reset timezone and boundary are not independently evidenced here.

implementation.supported_timezone_envelope: operator-supplied finite IANA timezone set; no default is assumed
implementation.safe_boundary: latest possible month-start across the approved envelope plus the configured delay
implementation.safe_period_end: earliest possible next-month start across the approved envelope
implementation.dst_and_month_length: calculated with zoneinfo for every candidate timezone
implementation.concurrency: SQL contract lock plus MonthKey/reconciliation-key idempotency
implementation.required_one_time_approval: operator must explicitly approve the calendar-month model and enumerate the supported timezone envelope

conservative_calendar_month_policy_evalu.reason: The reviewed public sources expose a monthly quota and request history but do not establish that this credential resets on a calendar month or identify a supported provider timezone. The bounded policy is implemented fail-closed, but neither its calendar-month model nor its supported timezone envelope has been approved.
conservative_calendar_month_policy_evalu.required_one_time_evidence: Provider-issued confirmation of the monthly-reset model, or explicit operator approval of a mathematically conservative latest-plausible-timezone policy with its finite supported timezone envelope and delay.

runtime_behavior.future_period_creation: SQL procedure is called only after a verified exact contract or an explicitly approved bounded calendar-month contract, its immutable evidence hash, conservative post-boundary delay, and all ledger stop conditions are satisfied.
runtime_behavior.without_contract: No zero-based future period is created and quota authorization remains unavailable after the applicable existing authorization expires.
runtime_behavior.outstanding_permits: Prior-period pending permits or untracked Tiered50 network attempts block rollover.
runtime_behavior.idempotence: The contract, MonthKey, period bounds, and evidence hash are locked and compared before any insert.

unresolved_dependency: Obtain provider-issued evidence for the exact MDD credential quota reset timezone/boundary and register it through the administrator-only SQL workflow before relying on automatic November or later rollover.
